# genedai.md

> Gene Dai — Product builder, Co-Founder & CPO of Metix AI, an AI-native hiring platform. Previously led products at BOSS Zhipin, Liepin, Zuoyebang, and Zhidemai Tech.

Based in California. Studied Computer Software Engineering at Beihang University. Areas of expertise: AI hiring, product management, user growth, platform products, HRTech.

## Profile

- [Personal homepage](https://genedai.md/): Hub for projects, writing, and contact.
- [Homepage as Markdown](https://genedai.md/genedai.md): The full homepage as a single Markdown file with YAML frontmatter.
- [Blog](https://genedai.me): Long-form writing on AI, HRTech, and product strategy.
- [Medium](https://genedai.medium.com): English articles on AI leaders, HRTech, and hiring.
- [Substack](https://genedai.substack.com): Newsletter on AI agents and the future of hiring.

## Projects

- [Metix](https://metix.ai): AI-native hiring platform. Define the role and meet interview-ready candidates; Metix AI reports 95% of roles get a first interview scheduled within 24 hours. Reached #1 on Product Hunt.
- [Raltic](https://raltic.com): Agent workflow rooms for product teams. Brief a cloud or local agent (Claude, Codex), inspect the proof, approve the decision, and keep the outcome searchable. Private beta.
- [VentureDex](https://venturedex.co): Startup research on products, funding, and investors. 400+ company profiles across AI agents, developer tools, healthcare, and more.
- [HireAI Directory](https://hireai.genedai.me): 249 HR AI products across five technology eras, from 1990s ATS to 2024+ agentic platforms, with analysis pages and evaluation checklists.
- [Website2Markdown](https://md.genedai.me): URL-to-Markdown converter on Cloudflare Workers with 16 platform adapters, a 5-layer fallback chain, and streaming, batch, extract, and deep-crawl APIs.
- [ModernCV](https://genedai.cv): Free AI resume builder with 28 templates and instant PDF export.
- [Recruit Navigator](https://recruit.genedai.me): Recruitment and AI hiring tools map inspired by OSINT-framework. 320 categories, 2,100+ resources.

## Career

- Co-Founder, Metix AI (2024–present): AI-native hiring platform.
- Head of Product Management, Zuoyebang: China's largest K12 online education platform.
- Head of Product, Liepin (6100.HK): Executive recruitment platform.
- Product Director, Zhidemai Tech (300785.SZ): Consumer content & commerce platform.
- Head of Product / Head of Product of Kanzhun.com, BOSS Zhipin (BZ/2076.HK): China's leading mobile recruiting platform.
- Senior Product Manager, Dora Tech: Sequoia Capital China backed.
- Co-founder & Chief Product Officer, Feel: Health & fitness app, ZhenFund backed.
